int_name: S CHRISTOPHER COLUMBUS BLVD & REED ST

result.summary: The image shows a wide signalized intersection adjacent to a commercial building with a marked continental crosswalk and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the multi-lane roadway creates a significant crossing distance for pedestrians without a refuge.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time and reduce exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.
